newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gemstar strong buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gemstar strong buy repeated.

text.p: -- Alex. Brown said it reiterated a strong buy recommendation on Gemstar International Group Ltd Friday, one day after the analyst lowered earings estimates on the company causing the stock to plummet.
-- Analyst Steven Eskenazi said, "My conviction in the company is unchanged. The sell-off yesterday was overblown.
-- Thursday, the shares fell 23 percent, or 4-7/8, to 16-1/4, a fall traders said was driven by Alex. Brown's lowered earnings outlook.
-- Friday morning, the shares rebounded partially with a three point rise to 19-1/4.
